items.title: Serene Living Suite
items.narrative:
This 2,400 sq ft residence in Vijay Nagar was designed for a young family seeking a warm, modern home that balances functionality with everyday comfort.

We began with an open-concept living and dining layout, using a neutral palette of ivory, warm wood tones, and soft brass accents to create a calm, cohesive flow throughout the space.

Custom storage solutions and thoughtfully layered lighting ensure the home feels effortless to live in, while remaining true to the family's personal style.
items.client_quote: Nikita Nawal Design Studio understood exactly what we wanted, even when we struggled to put it into words ourselves. Our home finally feels like us.

items.title: Riverside Office Fit-Out
items.narrative:
A growing consulting firm needed an office that reflected their brand while supporting focused, collaborative work.

We designed a layout that balances open workstations with quiet meeting pods, using warm materials and greenery to soften what could otherwise feel corporate.
items.client_quote: The space changed how our team works together. Clients notice it the moment they walk in.

items.title: Minimalist Master Suite
items.narrative:
A calm, clutter-free master suite designed for a client who wanted their bedroom to feel like a genuine retreat from a busy schedule.

We stripped the palette back to warm neutrals and natural textures, letting a single statement headboard and layered lighting do the work.
